market_outlook.short_term: High volatility expected. Oil at $108 and diesel at $6/gal create inflation stickiness, pressuring Fed toward a hike. CPI at 3.4% with energy component elevated limits rate-cut hopes. Markets may see a 'face-ripper rally' on any de-escalation but remain fragile. Bitcoin below $77K signals risk-off. Watch for Houthi escalation in Red Sea as primary catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes favor AI infrastructure (revenue-backed), energy transition (Europe solar storage gap), rare earths, and value consumer. BRICS realignment and multipolar geopolitics create supply chain diversification tailwinds. Housing affordability crisis may persist 12+ months. AI capex cycle likely continues but with sharper corrections. Pharma M&A and obesity drug pipeline remain multi-year catalysts.
